responsibility: Implements a MIR CFG simplification pass that removes impossible branches from `SwitchInt` tests over enum discriminants when some variants are uninhabited. It recognizes switches fed by `Discriminant` assignments, computes which discriminant values are actually reachable from the enum layout or variant range, rewrites impossible targets to shared unreachable blocks, and can tighten the `otherwise` branch when all remaining reachable variants are enumerated.
